audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Mel four stages and Skill three, with Sejuani never winning a stage, on a 45.65% Mel win rate over 92 games. The packet's own levelChart disagreed with both layers.
audit.why: Mel genuinely owns levels 1-5 as a 950/1000-range poke laner against a champion whose only gap-close is a 650-range charge on an 18s cooldown. The back end never caught up: content.late already says Sejuani wins the long game, and the mirror audit (audits/top/sejuani__mel.json) flipped the same two stages on her page.
audit.corrected: win[5], win[6], phases[5].side and phases[6].side now read Sejuani, matching the mirror. Ratings were already the inverse of Sejuani's page (4/10 vs her 6/10) so they stand.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late spike claimed 'Frostbite W shreds your squishy frame percent-HP'. Sejuani has no ability called Frostbite and nothing in her kit deals percent HP.
audit.why: Riot's text: W is Winter's Wrath, 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks'. Her actual late-game burst is Fury of the North's shatter — 'Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage' — which is gated behind a Permafrost stun at max Frost stacks. A player told to fear a percent-HP W will stack HP and still die to the shatter.
audit.corrected: Spike and late now name Winter's Wrath, Permafrost and the Frost Armor shatter, and the fabricated percent-HP line is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early put Permafrost on her passive and Arctic Assault on her E, and the page never once mentioned that Fury of the North grants slow immunity.
audit.why: Riot's text: passive is Fury of the North (Frost Armor: armour, MR, immunity to slows); Q is Arctic Assault, a 650-range charge on 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s; E is Permafrost, the stun at max Frost stacks. The slow immunity is the decisive interaction of the matchup — Solar Snare's slow ring is dead text while Frost Armor is up, so only the centre root holds her. The reflect side is settled by the mirror: Glacial Prison carries the projectile flag and Rebuttal sends the bola back; Arctic Assault is a charge with no projectile flag, so Rebuttal only blanks its damage.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected throughout, slow immunity stated, Glacial Prison reflection stated with the charge exception.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and its copies said Rebuttal is 'gone for twenty seconds', and breakdown.cooldowns gave Arctic Assault no number at all.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s — nearly double the stated figure at rank 1. Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. Understating your own defensive cooldown by 18 seconds is the error that gets a 550-range mage killed stepping up into a window that never reopened.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t both read 'Favoured matchup' on a 45.65% win rate, while diff already read HARD.
audit.why: Internally contradictory: the enum says HARD, the prose says favoured. The mirror rates the lane FAV for Sejuani at 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the player that Sejuani is slow-immune while Frost Armor holds.
audit.why: Mel's only peel is Solar Snare, and most of its area is a slow, not a root. Against Frost Armor the outer ring does nothing.
audit.corrected: wants.you and early now say to land the centre root, not to rely on the slow.

edits.before: Frostbite W shreds your squishy frame percent-HP and her R headlines the teamfight she scales into — she owns 2+ items.
edits.after: Permafrost stuns you at max Frost stacks and her next hit shatters you for massive magic damage — she owns 2+ items.

edits.before: Sejuani is an immobile tank with no dash, so your Solar Snare root and Q poke can punish her every time she steps up for a CS — that's your level 2 window, and it's real. But she does not care about chip the way a bruiser does: she stacks resists and her passive Permafrost is always charging. Never auto into a fully-stacked Permafrost or her next hit stuns you, and respect that her E (Arctic Assault) can charge through minions to land that stun if you stand on the wrong side of the wave.
edits.after: Sejuani does have a dash — Arctic Assault (Q), 650 range on 18s at rank 1 — so your level 2 Solar Snare window is real only while it is down. She also does not care about chip: Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants armour, magic resist and immunity to slows, so Solar Snare's outer slow ring is dead text and only the centre root holds her. Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost on you every swing; at max stacks Permafrost (E) stuns, and her next hit shatters you for massive magic damage.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your cleanest stretch — ranked Q plus stacking Overwhelm lets you erode even her armor-heavy bar from max range while she has no way to close the gap alone. Hold W (Rebuttal) to eat a projectile or to disengage, not to brawl. At 6 it equalizes: your Golden Eclipse converts stacks into burst, but her Glacial Prison ult is a long-range hard CC that catches you out of position and flips a fight, especially with jungle help. This is a coin-flip lane — you out-range her, she out-CCs you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your cleanest stretch — ranked Q plus stacking Overwhelm erodes even her armour-heavy bar from max range, and Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1, 650 range) is her only way in. Hold Rebuttal (W): 38s at rank 1 falling to 26, it prevents all damage and reflects projectiles. At 6 that decides the lane — Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola and it is a projectile, so a lit Rebuttal sends it straight back and stuns her in her own ice storm. Arctic Assault is a charge, not a projectile: Rebuttal only blanks its damage.

edits.before: She wins the long game. Frostbite (W) deals percent-current-HP magic damage, which is exactly what shreds your squishy 550-range frame, and her whole kit is built to land hard CC in the teamfights she scales into — Glacial Prison plus Permafrost lock you down before your stacks matter. You have zero dashes and one root to peel with. Keep your distance, hold W for her R cast, and let your frontline absorb her engage while you detonate from the back.
edits.after: She wins the long game. Frost Armor's armour and magic resist blunt your volleys, and the rest of her kit is hard CC: Winter's Wrath stacks Frost, Permafrost stuns at max stacks, and her follow-up hit shatters you for massive magic damage. Glacial Prison opens fights from 1300 range on a 120/105/90s cooldown. You have no dash and one root to peel with. Keep your distance, save Rebuttal for the bola, and let your frontline eat the engage while you detonate from the back.
